messages.subject: Next steps
messages.text:
Hi Shlomi,

Good call yesterday. To recap from our side: our contract with the current vendor ends on 31 January, so we need to be live before then. Legal will want to review your DPA. Can you send it over?

We'll also need onboarding for 3 sites. Our COO, Marcus Chen, makes the final call; I'm running the evaluation.

Alice Wong
Head of Customer Success

messages.subject: Re: Next steps
messages.text:
Thanks Alice. I'll send the DPA tomorrow, and I'll set up a call with our onboarding lead next week.

Shlomi
